BillHeading.BriefDescription: Limiting the scope of cause for loss of aid.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to limiting the scope of cause for loss of aid; and repealing RCW 28B.10.281.

BillSectionHeader.P: RCW 28B.10.281 (Student loans—Certain activities may make student ineligible for aid) and 1969 ex.s. c 222 s 3 are each repealed.
